input.prompt: The same premium silver 40-foot high-cube ISO shipping container, brushed metal corrugated walls, consistent corner castings and believable steel hardware. Three-quarter oblique at approximately mid-height, showing the closed double-door end and one full long side, with only a small roof edge visible; no overhead/roof-only or underside plate. Maintain nominal external proportions of 12.192 m length, 2.438 m width and 2.896 m height. Corrugated walls, roof, doors and structural frame have cool brushed silver with a restrained satin sheen and fine consistent grain. Corner castings, hinges, locking rods and handles are neutral silver/titanium metal; door seals are natural dark matte rubber. Isolated on transparency with comfortable margin, crisp realistic edges and restrained blue-tinted specular light in #7BCBFF and #B9E7FF. Maintain identical dimensions and structural details across later model views. No text, serial number, logo, baked shadow, yellow/gold glow, dents that change between views or scene background. No additional painted blue or carbon panel is requested. All painted carbon or graphite surfaces use Pegasoft carbon #11151B as their shared base paint color. Graphite describes the material appearance; do not introduce a separate grey-blue paint variant. Preserve the separately approved blue, brushed silver/titanium, rubber and glass material roles. Natural highlights and shadows come from lighting, not different paint colors.

recipe.note: These are the submitted inputs, not resolved server defaults. For a variation, copy them and change only requested fields; reuse returned_seed when supported by the schema. Source URLs may expire.

display_hint: Present completed media to the user. Forward attached image content blocks to the host's image display helper (for example, image(block)); do not stringify image blocks as text. For Markdown previews use previews[].preview_url, and separately link original_url as the full-resolution file. If no preview is available, show a clearly labeled original-file link. Do not claim a preview rendered unless it is visible. Video, audio and 3D URLs are original result files, not queue URLs.
